lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately six vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots, with each column containing 4 to 5 spots, forming a structured rectangular grid posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the spots, positioning each blob as a central node within the lighter vertical tracks.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring a high-intensity upper edge and a shadowed lower margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, high-contrast elongated feature is attached to the ventral-lateral area posterior to the pectoral fin; the cephalic region displays a transition to a significantly higher spatial frequency of smaller, irregular high-luminance spots compared to the mid-body flank.
